description: Source code for a launcher class that manages deploying, running, and debugging an Xbox application via the UWP Device Portal API, including handling app installation, uninstallation, crash detection, and process management.

classes.name: Launcher
classes.description: A class for launching, deploying, and managing Xbox applications via the UWP Device Portal API, including handling app installation, uninstallation, crash detection, and process control.

methods.name: ToAppxFriendlyName
methods.description: Converts a target name to a friendly appx name format.

methods.name: GlobalVars
methods.description: Returns a dictionary for storing global state across function calls.

methods.name: FirstRun
methods.description: Determines if this is the first time the launcher is run.

methods.name: GetXb1NetworkApiFor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a network API object for a given device ID and port.

methods.name: TryGetAppxDirectory
methods.description: Attempts to locate the appx directory containing the manifest.

methods.name: TryGetTargetPath
methods.description: Attempts to locate the target executable within the appx directory.

methods.name: TryGetPackagedBinary
methods.description: Locates the packaged appx binary file.

methods.name: CheckEnvironment
methods.description: Checks if the environment is supported (e.g., not Cygwin).

methods.name: CommandArgsToDict
methods.description: Parses a command-line argument string into a dictionary.

methods.name: Str2Bool
methods.description: Converts a string to a boolean value.

methods.name: InitTargetParams
methods.description: Initializes target parameters from a string, setting restart, deploy, and run flags.

methods.name: InstallStarboardArgument
methods.description: Installs or removes global command-line arguments for the app.

methods.name: GetSerial
methods.description: Retrieves the device serial number.

methods.name: RestartDevkit
methods.description: Restarts the Xbox devkit device.

methods.name: SignIn
methods.description: Signs into the Xbox device with a user account.

methods.name: WinAppDeployCmd
methods.description: Runs the WinAppDeployCmd utility with a specified command.

methods.name: PackageCobalt
methods.description: Packages the app into an appx package.

methods.name: UninstallSubPackages
methods.description: Uninstalls existing sub-packages matching certain names.

methods.name: DeleteLooseApps
methods.description: Deletes loose app files from the device.

methods.name: Deploy
methods.description: Handles deploying the app, including packaging, uninstalling existing versions, and installing dependencies.

methods.name: CheckPackageIsDeployed
methods.description: Checks if a package is currently deployed on the device.

methods.name: RunTest
methods.description: Runs a test application with retries and argument passing.

methods.name: InitDevice
methods.description: Initializes the device, ensuring dev mode is enabled and signing in.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Main entry point to run the application, handling first-time setup and subsequent runs.

methods.name: Run2
methods.description: Runs the application, manages logs, and detects crashes.

methods.name: _DetectAndHandleAnyCrashes
methods.description: Detects crash dump files for the app and saves/prints them.

methods.name: Kill
methods.description: Kills the running app process on the device.

methods.name: GetDeviceIp
methods.description: Returns the device IP address.

methods.name: GetDeviceOutputPath
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving device output path.
